item.tianyi.suminggu.tip.empty: No credential. This is an empty shell.
item.tianyi.suminggu.tip.scarred: Crimson scars split its carapace; its breath is unsteady.
item.tianyi.suminggu.tip.repair: Authentic ledger-approved copies only: hold it at an anvil; each offering uses 4 Gu Material Primordial Stones and 4 amethyst shards.
item.tianyi.suminggu.tip.ledger: It remembers the ledger state at its last check: %s
item.tianyi.suminggu.tip.verify: Whether it is real is not for it to say - the world ledger decides.
